tool.name: metilene
tool.description: calling differentially methylated regions from bisulfite sequencing data
tool.command: metilene_input.pl --in1 '$in1' --in2 '$in2' && metilene --maxdist $Options.maxdist --mincpgs $Options.mincpgs --minMethDiff $Options.minMethDiff --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4}" #if $bed: --mode 2 --bed '$bed' #else --mode 1 #end if --mtc $Options.mtc #if $Options.maxseg: --maxseg $Options.maxseg #end if #if $Options.minNoA: --minNoA $Options.minNoA #end if #if $Options.minNoB: --minNoB $Options.minNoB #end if --valley $Options.valley metilene_g1_g2.input > metilene_raw.out ## metilene emits the DMRs in genomic order only when run on a single thread, ## so the (otherwise identical) results are sorted here to keep the output ## deterministic and comparable regardless of the number of allocated slots. && LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n metilene_raw.out > '$output_bedlike' && cut -f1-4 '$output_bedlike' > '$output_bedgraph' && metilene_output.pl -q '$output_bedlike' -p 0.05 -o ./metilene

param.label: Group 1 input (e.g. treatment)
param.help: Multiple input files are allowed. All files have to be sorted by chromosome and position, e.g. with the Sort (bedtools) tool.

param.label: Group 2 input (e.g. control)
param.help: Multiple input files are allowed. All files have to be sorted by chromosome and position, e.g. with the Sort (bedtools) tool.

param.label: BED file with regions of interest
param.help: If this file is given, metilene will only search for DMRs in these regions (--mode 2 --bed). The file has to be sorted like the methylation data. If this field is left empty, metilene searches for DMRs de-novo (--mode 1).

param.label: Maximum distance between two CpGs in a DMR
Maximum segment length
param.help: Restricts the maximum length of the segments that are loaded into memory at once. Increase this value if metilene runs into memory problems. Leave empty to use the metilene default (-1: no limit). New option in metilene v0.2.8.

param.label: Minimum number of CpGs in a DMR
Minimum mean methylation difference
param.help: Effect size threshold: DMRs with a smaller absolute difference in mean methylation between the two groups are not reported.

param.label: Multiple testing correction
param.help: Method used to adjust the p-values for multiple testing. New option in metilene v0.2.8.

param.label: Stringency of the valley filter (0.0 - 1.0)
param.help: Controls how aggressively metilene splits a region into separate DMRs. A region is segmented further as long as a sub-window falls below this fraction of the mean methylation difference of the whole region, which prevents calling large regions with a dip in the difference signal as a single DMR. Lower the value to weaken the filter, use 0 to switch it off. This is not an effect size threshold - see the minimum mean methylation difference for that.

param.label: Minimum number of replicates with data in group 1
param.help: Metilene will skip regions where fewer than this number of group 1 replicates have data. Leave empty for no filtering.

param.label: Minimum number of replicates with data in group 2
param.help: Metilene will skip regions where fewer than this number of group 2 replicates have data. Leave empty for no filtering.

tool.help:
**metilene** calls differentially methylated regions (DMRs) from bisulfite sequencing data. It compares two groups of methylation profiles with a two-dimensional statistical test that takes both the methylation level and the coverage of each CpG into account.
-----
## Outputs
- **DMRs**: all detected DMRs with their adjusted p-value, mean methylation difference, number of CpGs and the mean methylation of both groups. - **DMRs (first 4 columns)**: the same regions as chromosome, start, end and adjusted p-value. - **Significant DMRs**: the subset of the DMRs above that passes the significance and effect size filters of metilene, as a table and as a bedgraph. - **Plots**: PDF with the methylation and the DMR length distributions.
